conversation.Statement: Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Li? This is Jessica from Amazon Customer Support. I'm calling regarding a recent alert on your Amazon account.
Yes, this is Li. What is the problem?

Thank you for confirming. We noticed an unusual attempt to purchase an Amazon gift card for $450 from your account. For your protection, the order is on hold. Has anyone else accessed your account recently?
No, only me. I not buy gift card. Why is this happen?

I understand your concern, Mr. Li. It's possible someone unauthorized gained access. I'm here to help you secure your account and make sure no unwanted charges go through. May I please confirm your registered email address for verification?
My email is linli88@gmail.com.
Thank you. For added security, could you also provide the phone number linked to your Amazon account?

Perfect. I'm running a quick check now. While I do that, please don't worry, Amazon takes these matters seriously, and we'll make sure your account is safe. Mr. Li, do you have a computer or smartphone available right now?
I have my phone, yes.
Great. For your security, I'll need you to open a secure Amazon support page. Could you please open your browser and go to www.amazonhelp-support.com?
Okay, I open browser, but website not loading. Is that correct address?
Sometimes there's a small delay, but yes, that is correct. Please try refreshing the page. You should see a blue button labeled 'Support Access'.
Yes, now I see. There is blue button.
Excellent. Please click that button, and it will prompt you to download a secure support app. This allows us to check the unauthorized activity together and fix it immediately.
It say download 'QuickAssist'? Should I do?
Yes, please click to download and install QuickAssist, it's Amazon's verified tool for remote troubleshooting. I will guide you every step, don't worry.
Okay, I installing now. My English not perfect, so can you explain slow?
Of course, Mr. Li. Take your time, I'm here to help. Once QuickAssist is installed, open it and you'll see a field to enter a code. Please let me know when you are ready.
Yes, I see code box.
Great. Please enter this code: 482912. That will allow our secure support connection.
I enter the number. Now it loading.
Perfect. Now, I see your request. For your safety, I'll need to check your recent orders. Please don't click or close anything for now.
Okay, I wait.

Thank you. I see a pending purchase for an Amazon gift card and a security hold on your account. To cancel the unauthorized charge and unlock your account, Amazon requires a temporary verification payment through Amazon gift cards.
I pay for something? But I did not do anything wrong.

I understand, Mr. Li. This is only a temporary measure to prove you are the true account owner. The payment will be fully refunded. If the verification is not completed, your account may remain frozen and you could be responsible for any illegal purchases.
Oh, I do not want account freeze. What I need do?

Please visit your nearest store, like Walmart, Target, or CVS, and purchase four Amazon gift cards of $100 each. When you have them, I'll help you enter the codes for verification. This is the fastest way to secure your account today.
I buy gift card and tell you number?

Yes, that's correct. Keep the receipts and cards safe. Once you provide the numbers, the verification is complete and your account will be unfrozen, with the $400 returned to your account within 24 hours.
Okay, I go to store now.

Thank you for your cooperation, Mr. Li. Please call me back at this number as soon as you have the cards. If you do not complete this process today, your account will be suspended and you may lose access permanently.
